en.title: Bitcoin ETFs Cool After $3B Streak While Fed Tensions and Whale Moves Reshape the Market
en.body:
Spot Bitcoin ETF flows reversed sharply this week, snapping a $3 billion streak with a $201.9 million outflow in a single session, according to CryptoSlate. Despite the pullback, the week remained net positive for $BTC, suggesting institutional appetite is cooling rather than collapsing. While Bitcoin funds bled capital, altcoin-focused products kept gathering inflows, with ETH, XRP and $SOL vehicles recording steady buying interest. The divergence hints at a rotation trade, with traders reallocating exposure across the top of the market rather than exiting crypto entirely.

The macro backdrop is doing little to ease uncertainty. CryptoSlate reports that newly appointed Fed Chair Kevin Warsh has flagged persistent inflation metrics, framing them as a meaningful hurdle for risk assets. Warsh acknowledged that ETF inflows and expanded Treasury buybacks can dampen volatility, but stressed that neither tool replaces genuine disinflation. His remarks arrive as traders reassess rate-cut expectations, keeping the dollar and yields in focus for every major asset class.

On-chain activity added another layer of caution. Japanese Bitcoin miner and treasury holder Metaplanet deposited roughly $237 million worth of $BTC, trimming its reserves during the recent price reversal, per U.Today. Mining firms selling into strength is a familiar pattern, but the size of the move drew attention from analysts tracking treasury balances as a proxy for long-term conviction.

Meme-coin flows told a similar cautionary story. U.Today reported that 145 billion $SHIB moved onto exchanges, pushing netflows into bearish territory after a recent breakout. The surge in sell-side deposits suggests short-term holders are using the rally to reduce exposure rather than accumulate, a classic distribution signal that often precedes range-bound action.

Together, the data paints a market in transition: institutional flows are rotating, macro headwinds are reasserting themselves, and both corporate treasuries and retail-heavy tokens are showing profit-taking behavior. Traders watching $BTC will likely keep an eye on the prior breakout zone as immediate support, while resistance near recent highs could cap upside until inflation prints soften.
